guidance.statement: Now our target is 45 GW by the same time. It is now revised from 42 to 45.
This year, we are expecting that our expansion CapEx will be near about INR25,000 crores.
Next year, it will be near about INR33,000 crores, and thereafter it will be more than INR35,000 crores.
We are expecting that net debt-to-EBITDA will not cross 3 times at any point.

S.B. Adani Family Trust declared no encumbrance on Adani Power Limited shares under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for FY2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹14,223.09 Cr (-0.1% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹4,017.08 Cr (+52.3% YoY).
Adani Power reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹57,865 Cr and net profit of ₹12,971 Cr with an installed capacity of 18,150 MW.

Adani Power reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹15,989 Cr and net profit of ₹12,971 Cr for the full year, backed by a 13.3 GW tied-up expansion pipeline.
Adani Power informed the exchange that its response is awaited regarding a news item on CCI approval for acquiring GVK Energy.
Adani Power clarified that its resolution plan for GVK Energy under CIRP has received CCI approval but awaits CoC voting.
Adani Power incorporated Integrated Power Supply Limited as a wholly owned subsidiary on May 14, 2026.

Adani Power executed definitive agreements with Jaiprakash Associates to acquire a 24% stake in JPVL, a 180 MW thermal power plant in Churk, and an 11.49% stake in Prayagraj Power Generation for a total cash consideration of ₹4,193.59 Cr.

Adani Power said its 22 July 2026 board meeting will also consider raising funds via equity shares or other eligible securities, including QIP or preferential issue, subject to approvals.

Adani Power reported Q1FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹18,902 Cr (+34% YoY) and PAT of ₹4,867 Cr (+47% YoY), and its board approved a QIP of up to ₹15,000 Cr and a borrowing limit increase to ₹1,00,000 Cr, with an EGM set for 14 August 2026.
Adani Power reported Q1FY27 results with 32.6% revenue growth and 47.2% PAT growth, and its board approved a QIP of up to ₹15,000 Cr.
Adani Power's Q1FY27 earnings call raised the capacity target to 45 GW from 42 GW on the same timeline; and said the ₹15,000 Cr QIP is only an enabling provision.
